rows.role_title: Председатель Правительства — Chairman of the Government
rows.text: A. A. Kotenkov, the President's plenipotentiary representative in the State Duma, states that under Article 111(3) of the Constitution and in connection with the Duma's rejection of the candidacy submitted by the President, the President has submitted the candidacy of Kiriyenko Sergei Vladilenovich for consent, and on the President's instruction presents him to the deputies.
rows.locator: Morning session, statement of Котенков А.А. before the candidate's address

rows.role_title: Председатель Правительства — Chairman of the Government
rows.text: The Duma first adopts an open ballot on Kiriyenko's candidacy (13:52:29: 272 for, 102 against, 2 abstentions, 'принято'); the question 'кто за то, чтобы дать согласие Президенту на назначение Сергея Владиленовича Кириенко Председателем Правительства' then fails (13:54:16: 115 for, 271 against, 11 abstentions, 397 voting, 'Результат: не принято').
rows.locator: Afternoon: 'Результаты голосования (13 час. 52 мин. 29 сек.)' and '(13 час. 54 мин. 16 сек.)'

rows.role_title: Председатель Правительства — Chairman of the Government
rows.text: Asked whether the President had submitted Kiriyenko's candidacy a third time, as news agencies reported, the presiding Chairman says that no official letter had yet reached the Duma ('пока письмо официально не пришло') and that the previous one had arrived at 16:00.
rows.locator: Afternoon, after the break: question of Захаров А.К. and the Chairman's reply
